         browser bridge  login.claude = "sandbox" — the sandbox may ask snug to open a Claude login page
                         in YOUR browser, directly, one at a time. Accepted shape:
                         https://claude.com/cai/oauth/authorize
                         client 9d1c250a-e61b-44d9-88ed-5944d1962f5e, exactly 7 scopes:
                         org:create_api_key user:profile user:inference
                         user:sessions:claude_code user:mcp_servers user:file_upload user:plugins;
                         anything else is REFUSED, and snug rebuilds the URL it opens
                         from its own constants.
                         callback: snug binds localhost:<port> (127.0.0.1 and ::1) on
                         the host only while a login is pending (at most 10m0s), admits
                         your uid only, relays ONE rebuilt GET /callback into the
                         sandbox and answers your browser itself. Nothing is forwarded
                         into the sandbox's namespace; host loopback stays unreachable
                         from inside.
         opener          desktop portal, org.freedesktop.portal.OpenURI version 5, on the session bus unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus
         limits          5 opens and 3 callbacks per run, 1 login pending at a time
